name: renos
description: RenOS – eine Desktop-Umgebung als Progressive Web App für das iPad, mit Bibliothek und Player für Ren'Py-Web-Builds.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @renos/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @renos/server" "npm run dev -w @renos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @renos/shared && npm run build -w @renos/server && npm run build -w @renos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @renos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @renos/server && npm run typecheck -w @renos/web && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @renos/shared && npm run test -w @renos/server && npm run test -w @renos/web
scripts.build:pages: npm run build -w @renos/shared && RENOS_BASE=${RENOS_BASE:-/renos/} VITE_RENOS_BACKEND=local npm run build:local -w @renos/web && node scripts/pages-runtimes.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:local: RENOS_BASE=/renos/ VITE_RENOS_BACKEND=local npm run build:pages && playwright test -c playwright.local.config.ts
